name: Sustainergy Cooperative
old_description: Improving your energy efficiency and installing solar panels go hand in hand! Both contribute to lower energy bills, fewer carbon emissions, and a cleaner, healthier home. Sustainergy Cooperative believes that insulation and solar panels are powerful on their own and unbeatable together. We are the only company that specializes in both insulation and solar energy services in the Columbus & Greater Cincinnati area.
about:
Sustainergy Cooperative operates from Cincinnati, Ohio, serving the Greater Cincinnati and Columbus regions. The company is structured as a worker-owned cooperative, meaning every employee has the opportunity to become a worker-owner, a model the firm says aligns employee incentives with customer outcomes.

The business provides two core service lines that it positions as complementary: building-envelope upgrades and on-site solar generation. Its insulation work covers attic, wall, and crawl-space insulation, air sealing, and removal of damaged or moldy material, backed by a ten-year warranty on crawl-space encapsulation. On the energy side, it designs and installs custom rooftop photovoltaic systems and adds battery storage for backup power. The company also performs whole-home energy audits to identify low-cost, high-impact improvements.

Customers are primarily residential and commercial property owners in the Columbus and Greater Cincinnati area looking to reduce utility bills and carbon emissions. Testimonials cite projects ranging from attic and exterior-wall insulation to full solar arrays that offset roughly 75 percent of annual electricity use.

Sustainergy was founded on the premise that insulation and solar are more effective together than separately, and that a worker-ownership structure produces higher-quality installations because the technicians have a direct stake in the company's reputation.
